headline: BenDaDonnn FaceTimed Ice Spice pretending to be a 49ers wide receiver and tried to ask her
body:
BenDaDonnn FaceTimed Ice Spice pretending to be a 49ers wide receiver and tried to ask her out and she hung up on him 😭😭😂
Via; @bendadonnn 

He hit Ice Spice with the “I’m not just regular rich, I’m rich asf now.” Ice sat through a few seconds of it, clocked the bit, and hung up. He ran the same call on Rubi Rose. She hung up too. Both clips have been circulating on X all day.

This comes after A guy named Daejon Love just got charged for posing as a 49ers WR and scamming women out of about $1.3 million. Real 49ers players have already reacted to it. So when BenDaDonnn puts the jersey on and FaceTimes rappers asking for a date, people already know the reference. Ice didn’t play along. She ended the call immediately 😭😂
